name: White Wine Vinegar
siboNotes: Vinegar is generally well-tolerated and may have antimicrobial properties that could benefit SIBO management. Use freely in dressings and marinades.
preparationTips: Use as a base for low-FODMAP salad dressings with olive oil and herbs
Add to marinades for meat and fish to enhance flavor
Use in pickling vegetables like carrots and radishes
Store in a cool, dark place - vinegar has a long shelf life
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like basil and oregano
nutritionalHighlights: Very low in calories (about 3 per tablespoon)
Contains acetic acid which may aid digestion
No added sugars or preservatives needed
